text: 白饭钓竿（Rice on a Stick）是面向 dsh Web 和桌面客户端的 DSH 插件，通过 Streamable HTTP MCP 服务和 dsh 会话内的 rice_ 原生工具提供会话控制。它可以创建会话并发送首条消息，向已有会话投递消息、查看运行状态与结果，还能处理权限审批和模型提问，并发现或调用 dsh 远程端点。适合希望从 MCP 客户端或当前 dsh 会话管理 DeepSeek Harness 工作流的用户。MCP 服务默认监听本机 127.0.0.1:5642；可在侧栏配置监听和认证。

Rice on a Stick lets web and desktop DSH users control sessions through MCP or native rice_ tools. Create sessions, send tasks, inspect status, answer approvals and questions, and call dsh endpoints. MCP listens on 127.0.0.1:5642 by default; listener and authentication settings are configurable.
想让 MCP 客户端创建 dsh 会话并直接发送第一条任务。
我需要从 agent 给现有的 dsh 会话继续发消息，并查看执行状态。
能不能批量查看多个会话是否运行、排队或等待审批？
希望通过 MCP 处理 dsh 工具调用的权限请求和模型提出的问题。
我想从外部 MCP 工具发现并调用 DeepSeek Harness 提供的远程端点。
I want an MCP client to create a dsh session and send its first task in one call.
How can I check several running dsh sessions and see their pending approvals or questions?
Let my dsh session use the plugin tools directly without configuring a separate MCP client.
白饭钓竿 的功能「创建并启动会话」：MCP 调用方可指定工作区、模型、预设和首条任务，在一次调用中创建 dsh 会话并投递任务。
白饭钓竿 的功能「观察会话」：调用方可向一个或多个会话发送消息、轮询状态，并按请求标识获取任务结果。
白饭钓竿 的功能「审批与端点控制」：可列出并回答会话权限审批，也可发现 dsh 远程端点并发起端点调用。
白饭钓竿 的功能「dsh 内置工具」：插件将同一 MCP 工具集注册为 rice_ 前缀的 dsh 原生工具，供当前会话直接调用。
白饭钓竿 使用前须知：MCP HTTP 服务默认只绑定本机 127.0.0.1:5642；认证由配置控制，默认关闭。
dsh-rice-on-a-stick README · Introduction：

dsh-rice-on-a-stick README · 白饭钓竿：中文 | [English](README.en.md) [](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) [](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-rice-on-a-stick) [](https://github.com/Leawind/dsh-rice-on-a-stick/releases) [](https://github.com/Leawind/dsh-rice-on-a-stick/commits/main) 一个将控制 dsh ([DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness)) 的能力暴露为 MCP 和内置工具的插件。

dsh-rice-on-a-stick README · 白饭钓竿：- **控制会话**：新建、发送、排队、分叉、归档与恢复、切换模型等
  - 可配置为只允许调用方使用特定模型，也可为模型提供商和模型编写描述提供给调用方
- **像网页用户一样与会话交互**：调用方通过本插件可像 web 端用户一样处理权限审批与提问
- **dsh 端点直通**：调用 dsh 的远程访问端点，端点策略三档可配：允许、需审批、拒绝
- **dsh 自己也能用**：这些能力同时注册为 dsh 的内置工具，本 dsh 实例无需额外接入 MCP
- **安全默认**：默认只监听本机，可配置访问令牌。

> [!WARNING]
>
> - 未启用认证时，任何能访问对应端口的本机进程都可以驱动 dsh
> - 这个插件会对调用者暴露本机代码执行能力，默认只监听 `127.0.0.1`

dsh-rice-on-a-stick README · 环境要求：- dsh `0.2.1-rc.5` 及以上。图形界面（侧栏“白饭钓竿”页）和完整的会话功能需要 web 或 desktop 版 dsh
- MCP 客户端需支持 Streamable HTTP，只支持 stdio 的客户端需要自行桥接

dsh-rice-on-a-stick README · 安装：通过 npm 安装：

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-rice-on-a-stick
```

通过源码安装：

```sh
git clone https://github.com/Leawind/dsh-rice-on-a-stick
cd dsh-rice-on-a-stick
npm install
npm run build
dsh plugin --profile web add link:.

dsh-rice-on-a-stick README · 监听源码变动并实时构建：npm run dev
```

卸载：

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web remove dsh-rice-on-a-stick
```

text: dsh-rice-on-a-stick README · 接入 MCP 客户端：MCP server 默认监听 `http://127.0.0.1:5642/mcp`，传输方式为 Streamable HTTP；可在设置中启用认证。
dsh-rice-on-a-stick README · 配置：所有配置都可在 dsh 侧栏的"白饭钓竿"页里改。
dsh-rice-on-a-stick README · 发送消息：`session_send` 向会话发消息。目标会话正在运行时须显式选择投递方式：排队（等当前回合结束）或插话（在步边界注入并延长本轮）；空闲时二者等价，运行中不指定会直接失败。
dsh-rice-on-a-stick README · 观察会话状态：`session_poll` 批量观察会话状态：状态、排队数、待回答项与最后一条消息。
dsh-rice-on-a-stick README · 处理权限审批与提问：像网页用户一样处理权限审批（`approval_list` / `approval_answer`）与回答模型的提问（`question_list` / `question_answer`）。
dsh-rice-on-a-stick README · 调用 dsh 的远程访问端点：发现（`endpoint_describe`）并调用（`endpoint_call`）dsh 的远程访问端点，机制见 [docs/endpoint-passthrough.zh.md](docs/endpoint-passthrough.zh.md)。

dsh-rice-on-a-stick README · Rice on a Stick：[中文](README.md) | English [](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) [](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-rice-on-a-stick) [](https://github.com/Leawind/dsh-rice-on-a-stick/releases) [](https://github.com/Leawind/dsh-rice-on-a-stick/commits/main) A plugin that exposes control over dsh ([DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness)) as MCP and built-in tools.

dsh-rice-on-a-stick README · Rice on a Stick：- **Control sessions**: create, send, queue, fork, archive and restore, switch models, etc.
  - Can be configured so that callers may only use specific models; descriptions for model providers and models can also be written and provided to callers
- **Interact with sessions like a web user**: through this plugin, callers can handle permission approvals and questions just like a web user
- **dsh endpoint passthrough**: call dsh's remote access endpoints; endpoint policy has three configurable levels: allow, require approval, deny
- **dsh itself can use it too**: these capabilities are also registered as dsh's built-in tools, so this dsh instance needs no extra MCP setup
- **Secure by default**: listens only on localhost by default, with a configurable access token.

dsh-rice-on-a-stick README · Rice on a Stick：> [!WARNING]
>
> - When authentication is disabled, any local process that can access the corresponding port can drive dsh
> - This plugin exposes local code execution capability to callers and listens only on `127.0.0.1` by default

dsh-rice-on-a-stick README · Requirements：- dsh `0.2.1-rc.5` or later. The graphical interface (the "Rice on a Stick" page in the sidebar) and full session functionality require the web or desktop version of dsh
- MCP clients must support Streamable HTTP; clients that only support stdio need to bridge it themselves

dsh-rice-on-a-stick README · Installation：Install via npm:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-rice-on-a-stick
```

Install from source:

```sh
git clone https://github.com/Leawind/dsh-rice-on-a-stick
cd dsh-rice-on-a-stick
npm install
npm run build
dsh plugin --profile web add link:.

dsh-rice-on-a-stick README · Watch source changes and build in real time：npm run dev
```

Uninstall:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web remove dsh-rice-on-a-stick
```

text: dsh-rice-on-a-stick README · Connecting to MCP clients：The MCP server listens on `http://127.0.0.1:5642/mcp` by default, with Streamable HTTP as the transport; authentication can be enabled in settings.
dsh-rice-on-a-stick README · Configuration：All configuration can be changed on the "Rice on a Stick" page in the dsh sidebar.

dsh-rice-on-a-stick README · Sending messages：`session_send` sends a message to a session. If the target session is running, the delivery mode must be chosen explicitly: queue (wait until the current turn ends) or steer (inject at a step boundary and extend this turn). When the session is idle, the two are equivalent; omitting the mode while the session is running fails directly.
dsh-rice-on-a-stick README · Observing session state：`session_poll` observes multiple sessions at once: state, queue length, pending answers and the last message.

dsh-rice-on-a-stick README · Handling permission approvals and questions：Handle permission approvals (`approval_list` / `approval_answer`) and answer the model's questions (`question_list` / `question_answer`) just like a web user.

dsh-rice-on-a-stick README · Calling dsh's remote access endpoints：Discover (`endpoint_describe`) and call (`endpoint_call`) dsh's remote access endpoints; for the mechanism, see [docs/endpoint-passthrough.zh.md](docs/endpoint-passthrough.zh.md).
